[SWS_DM_00961] Configuration of a DTCs significance as extended data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_SIGNIFICANCE
, the DM
shall set the value of this
internal data element
to the DTCs significance as-
signed by
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.significance
for this DTC and map
it:
• "0" =
occurence
.
• "1" =
fault
.
The length of this
internal DiagnosticDataElement
is one byte.
⌋
